methodologyNotes: Covers standalone consumer and prosumer 360-degree cameras with two or more back-to-back lenses that stitch a full spherical (360x180) image in-camera, sold at a published US MSRP. Excludes single-lens 180/VR180 cameras, panoramic-only robotic heads, and smartphone add-on lenses. Price is MSRP/typical street price in USD for the standalone camera or base combo. videoResolutionK is the maximum stitched 360 video resolution expressed in K (horizontal-equivalent thousands of pixels), e.g. 8 for 8K, 5.7 for 5.7K. maxVideoFps is the frame rate in fps at that maximum resolution. photoResolutionMp is the maximum stitched 360 still resolution in megapixels. sensorSize is the diagonal of each individual lens sensor as an inch fraction string (e.g. "1/1.28"). apertureF is the fixed lens aperture as an f-number (lower is brighter). waterproofDepthM is the rated waterproof depth in meters without an external housing; 0 if not waterproof without a case. batteryLifeMin is the manufacturer-rated maximum continuous recording time in minutes. internalStorageGb is built-in storage capacity in GB; 0 if the camera records to removable media only. displaySizeIn is the rear touchscreen diagonal in inches; 0 if there is no built-in screen. replaceableLens is a boolean for whether the lenses are user-replaceable. weightGrams is the camera body weight in grams.
